name: Fahim Project & Post Type Builder
author: Fahim Web Developer

sections.description:
Unlock the full potential of your WordPress site with the Fahim Project & Post Type Builder plugin — the ultimate solution for showcasing content in a beautifully tailored and fully customizable format. Whether you’re a freelancer, creative, or entrepreneur, this powerful tool puts you in control of how your content is displayed.

Design and manage stunning portfolios, highlight your best work, share compelling case studies, feature client testimonials, or present any custom post type — all without writing a single line of code. With a user-friendly interface and flexible layout options, creating a dynamic and engaging digital experience has never been easier.

Features included

  • Flexible Post Type Creation: Build unlimited custom post types effortlessly, organizing your content according to your preferences.
  • Responsive Design: Ensure a seamless user experience across all devices with responsive and mobile-friendly portfolio layouts.
  • User-Friendly Interface: Enjoy a user-friendly and intuitive interface that makes portfolio creation and management a breeze, even for users with limited technical expertise.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins in the Admin menu
  2. Click on the button Add new
  3. Search for Fahim Project & Post Type Builder and click ‘Install Now’ or click on the upload link to upload fahim-project-post-type-builder.zip
  4. Click on Activate plugin
